//: IHP SG13G2 hardening configuration
Targeting IHP SG13G2 130nm process via IHP Open PDK.
Key differences from Sky130 config:
- CLOCK_PERIOD 25ns (40 MHz): conservative for IHP slow corner
- PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT 60: IHP has ~78 std cells vs Sky130's 400+, needs more room
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - Lower density to give the smaller IHP cell library room to place.
CLOCK_PERIOD - 25ns == 40 MHz, conservative for IHP slow corner.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
